# How many male vs female tortises at each site?


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mf_count <- body %>%
  group_by(year, season, locality, sex) %>%
  summarise(count = n())
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}

```
`summarise()` has grouped output by 'year', 'season', 'locality'. You can
override using the `.groups` argument.
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
mf_count %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ locality)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](index_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-2-1.png){width=672}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
mf_count %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count, colour = sex)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ locality)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](index_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-2-2.png){width=672}
:::
:::


What is the ratio of male:female at each site?

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mf_ratio <- mf_count %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_m_f = sum(count[sex == "m"]) /
                sum(count[sex == "f"])
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

mf_ratio %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = ratio_m_f, colour = locality)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(y = "Male:Female", x = "Year") 
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](index_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=672}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
mf_ratio %>% ggplot(aes(x = year, y = ratio_m_f)) +
   geom_text(label = "🐢", size = 6) +
  labs(y = "Male:Female", x = "Year") 
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](index_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-2.png){width=672}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
mf_ratio %>%
  filter(locality == "Plateau") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count, colour = sex)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()
```
